summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, expertise in big data technologies (Apache Spark, Hadoop), strong interest in machine learning, advocates for technical meritocracy, critical of corporate hiring practices, believes in the importance of management training, values diplomatic communication in workplace dynamics, concerned about social issues (homelessness, healthcare), supports data privacy, critical of government surveillance, engaged in discussions about open-source software and its implications, skeptical of tech industry practices regarding user data and privacy.
